laws.name: phase intertwining / rational monodromy conjugacy
laws.law: M_(t+1) A_t=A_t M_t; det(A_t)!=0 implies rational conjugacy and phase-invariant characteristic polynomial/determinant.
laws.boundary: Declared periodic nonsingular integer-linear heartbeat only.

laws.name: residual extension / carry law
laws.law: 0->coker(A)->coker(BA)->coker(B)->0 for injective integer A then B; residual cardinalities multiply and nonsplit extensions encode carry coupling.
laws.boundary: Classical finite-abelian extension applied to raw X6.

laws.name: phase carry holonomy
laws.law: Periodic phase cuts have equal residual cardinality but can have nonisomorphic cokernels under nonunimodular phase transport; exact X6 witness is Z/2xZ/2 versus Z/4.
laws.boundary: Nonunimodular is enabling, not sufficient; project terminology only.

laws.name: six-axis cyclic radix staircase
laws.law: For A_b(z)=(b z6,z1,...,z5), A_b^6=bI; if k=6q+r then Smith factors are b^q repeated 6-r and b^(q+1) repeated r.
laws.boundary: Canonical cyclic radix family only; b and six-beat program are not world axioms.

laws.name: residual-branch duality
laws.law: For det M!=0, z=Mq+r is unique after choosing residue reps. Forgetting r creates exactly |det M| inverse fine branches; cyclic radix k-beat count is b^k.
laws.boundary: Support/branch count only; no intrinsic uniform weights.

laws.name: heartbeat translation dressing
laws.law: For cycle affine F_t(z)=M_tz+c_t and translation T_u, F_t T_u=T_(M_tu) F_t; ordering defect is (M_t-I)u.
laws.boundary: Time-ordered affine composition, not failure of static commutative addition.

laws.name: cyclic weighted valuation balancing
laws.law: For cyclic positive integer axis factors b_i, A_b^6=(product b_i)I. If k=6q+r, p-adic Smith depths are sorted cyclic r-window sums q*sum_i v_p(b_i)+sum_(j<r)v_p(b_(i+j)); complete cycles add equal depth to all axes and within-cycle anisotropy is bounded/periodic.
laws.boundary: Fixed cyclic per-axis-factor heartbeat family only; arbitrary periodic integer programs need not scalarize or have bounded valuation anisotropy.

laws.name: periodic monomial p-adic drift criterion
laws.law: For a periodic integer-monomial heartbeat, let M be one-period monodromy. For each permutation cycle C of M set mu_C=(sum_{j in C} v_p(w_j))/|C|. The p-adic Smith-depth spread over time is bounded iff all mu_C are equal. Unequal cycle means give linear anisotropy drift. The verdict is invariant under heartbeat phase shift.
laws.boundary: Periodic monomial (axis permutation plus nonzero integer scaling) programs only; general integer matrices with axis mixing require different valuation-slope machinery.

laws.name: general Newton carry-slope law
laws.law: For nonsingular integer M and prime p, if s_i(n) are p-valuations of Smith factors of M^n and lambda_i are sorted p-adic valuations of eigenvalues, then s_i(n)=n*lambda_i+epsilon_i(n) for all sufficiently large n with epsilon_i eventually periodic. Hence Smith-depth spread/n -> lambda_max-lambda_min and is bounded iff all lambda_i are equal.
laws.boundary: Derived from classical Smith-power eventual periodicity applied to compound matrices plus Newton-polygon root valuations; fixed nonsingular integer monodromy only.

laws.name: finite phase holonomy / asymptotic slope separation
laws.law: Phase monodromies of one periodic heartbeat are rationally conjugate, hence have identical Newton carry-slope spectra even when their finite cokernel/Smith group types differ.
laws.boundary: Asymptotic slope equality does not erase finite phase-sensitive carry structure.

laws.name: beatwise carry balance is not compositional
laws.law: There exist integer X6 beats A,B that are individually p-carry-balanced (A^2=B^2=2I blockwise) while the two-beat monodromy BA has carry slopes (0,0,0,2,2,2), producing linear Smith-depth drift.
laws.boundary: Counterexample to local/beatwise certification; period monodromy must be checked.

laws.name: Archimedean scale / p-adic carry observer separation
laws.law: Equal ordinary eigenvalue magnitudes need not imply equal p-adic carry slopes, and equal p-adic carry slopes need not imply equal ordinary eigenvalue magnitudes.
laws.boundary: Observer-separation result; neither spectrum replaces the other.

external_basis: classical p-adic Newton polygon root-valuation theorem
